title.narrative: In 2025, UNICEF-supported government to strengthen programmes that reached 52.4 million children through growth monitoring, treated 1.45 million severely wasted children, and expanded community-based programme for management of malnutrition to all districts in 12 out of 14 UNICEF supported states. State guidelines reflected a renewed thrust and commitment to deliver early growth faltering interventions through community-based health and nutrition platforms. Over 12.6 million community-based events organized by the Government for promoting infant feeding and care practices.
A nutrition policy or strategy to prevent undernutrition and micronutrient deficiencies in children under 5 years exists and is being implemented
